entries.value: Reward: an artifact, a hearthstone, a demesne
A person in danger the PC cares about (or could)
A debt owed to the PC comes due
Tribe / cult / charge the PC protects is threatened
A rival the PC wants to thwart is involved
A chance to grow a Project (build, rally, claim)
Knowledge: a First Age secret, a lost name
Reputation / a chance to be seen as a god
An oath or Intimacy demands action
A faction offers patronage for one job
Simple justice: a wrong the PC can't walk past
